commands.install_python: python3 -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip install reportlab flask flask-cors
commands.run_cli_tex_prototype: cd backend && python3 nuts_calc_tex.py <paper_size> <command> [options]  # requires pdflatex; backend/app.py selects it with NUTS_CALC_RENDERER=latex; factory.sh does not use it

notes.package_manager: No requirements.txt/pyproject.toml/setup.py exists for the Python side (a prior setup.py was removed per commit d9fc0a3, verified: 'git log -- backend/nuts_calc.py'). README.md's Setup/Dependencies sections describe installing Flask/Flask-Cors/reportlab manually via pip. frontend/spa and frontend/web each have their own independent package.json/package-lock.json for npm.
notes.ci: No .github/workflows directory or other CI definition exists in this repo (verified: 'find .github -type f' returns nothing).
notes.restructure_issue_88: The repo was reorganized in issue #88 from a web/{backend,frontend} layout to backend/ + frontend/{spa,web}, consolidating nuts_calc.py/nuts_calc_tex.py/factory.sh/vendor/texmf/tests/pytest.ini (previously at the repo root and web/backend/) into a single self-contained backend/ tree, moving the existing React SPA unchanged from web/frontend to frontend/spa, and adding frontend/web as a new lightweight, Japanese-only, no-i18n-library static multi-page implementation (HTML/CSS(Sass)/JS via Vite) that shares the same backend/ Flask API. backend/renderers.py's script-path resolution was updated accordingly (self-relative to backend/ instead of two levels up from web/backend/).
notes.tests: backend/tests/ contains 18 Python test_*.py files (backend/pytest.ini: testpaths=tests, pythonpath=. -- still resolves correctly from backend/ after the move). Collected 420 tests on 2026-08-12. Excluding backend/tests/test_nuts_calc_init.py, 398 tests pass, including pdflatex-dependent tests (running the full suite without --ignore reports 411 passed, 9 failed). The excluded file has 9 known stale failures and 13 passes. frontend/spa has 3 node:test files (17 tests total), all passing when invoked explicitly with node --test; its package.json has no test script. frontend/web has no automated tests.
notes.known_defects: npm run lint (frontend/spa) currently fails once at frontend/spa/src/drillPresets.js:433 because no-irregular-whitespace rejects a Japanese full-width space in a comment (line number shifted from :363 as presets were added; same underlying issue, not a regression). Separately, backend/tests/test_nuts_calc_init.py has 9 known-stale failures that are not a nuts_calc.py implementation defect. frontend/web has no lint script configured.
notes.nuts_calc_tex_py: Experimental LaTeX renderer with zero code sharing with nuts_calc.py. It implements the seven ReportLab-compatible commands plus the LaTeX-only frac, mixed, and compare commands (ten commands total). It supports exact fractions, decimal arithmetic, mixed int/decimal/fraction expressions, and carry/borrowing constraints for two-term integer addition/subtraction. Requires pdflatex and vendors longdivision under backend/vendor/texmf/ (path resolved relative to nuts_calc_tex.py's own file location, so it continued to work unmodified through the issue #88 move). backend/renderers.py selects it with NUTS_CALC_RENDERER=latex; both frontend/spa and frontend/web hide LaTeX-only cards when the reportlab renderer is active.
